description:
An interruptible, voltage-dependent ZIP load whose demand can be curtailed through demand response programs, subject to an interruption cost.

Like `StandardLoad`, it breaks the ZIP into three pieces: Z (constant impedance), I (constant current), and P (constant power), according to `P = P_P * V^0 + P_I * V^1 + P_Z * V^2` for active power and `Q = Q_P * V^0 + Q_I * V^1 + Q_Z * V^2` for reactive power. (Voltage V is in per unit.) Unlike `StandardLoad`, it carries an `operation_cost` for interrupting the load.

For a non-interruptible ZIP load, see `StandardLoad`. For an interruptible constant-power load, see `InterruptiblePowerLoad`.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the component. Components of the same type (e.g., `InterruptibleStandardLoad`) must have unique names, but components of different types (e.g., `InterruptibleStandardLoad` and `ACBus`) can have the same name.

available.description: Indicator of whether the component is connected and online (`true`) or disconnected, offline, or down (`false`). Unavailable components are excluded during simulations.

bus.description: ID of the bus that this component is connected to.

base_power.description: Base power of the load for per unitization. Units: MVA.

operation_cost.description: Operational cost of interrupting load. or MarketBidCost

conformity.description: Indicates whether the specified load is conforming or non-conforming.

constant_active_power.description: Constant active power demand (P_P). Units: MW.

constant_reactive_power.description: Constant reactive power demand (Q_P). Units: MVAr.

impedance_active_power.description: Active power coefficient for constant impedance load (P_Z). Units: MW.

impedance_reactive_power.description: Reactive power coefficient for constant impedance load (Q_Z). Units: MVAr.

current_active_power.description: Active power coefficient for constant current load (P_I). Units: MW.

current_reactive_power.description: Reactive power coefficient for constant current load (Q_I). Units: MVAr.

max_constant_active_power.description: Maximum active power drawn by constant power load. Units: MW.

max_constant_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power drawn by constant power load. Units: MVAr.

max_impedance_active_power.description: Maximum active power drawn by constant impedance load. Units: MW.

max_impedance_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power drawn by constant impedance load. Units: MVAr.

max_current_active_power.description: Maximum active power drawn by constant current load. Units: MW.

max_current_reactive_power.description: Maximum reactive power drawn by constant current load. Units: MVAr.

dynamic_injector.description: ID of the corresponding dynamic injection device, if any.
